description: NORMA 3.0 is an interactive, browser-based platform for the visualization, analysis and comparison of annotated biological networks. It supports directed and multi-edge networks and offers advanced group representations, including convex hulls, bubble sets, fog clouds and pie-chart nodes, alongside customizable colors, shapes and edge styles. Users can explore 18 two-dimensional and nine three-dimensional layouts, including group-aware arrangements, and quantitatively evaluate their ability to separate annotated groups using built-in scoring and benchmarking. NORMA 3.0 also provides network imports from six databases, group and functional enrichment statistics, and side-by-side comparison of up to ten networks. Publication-quality figures, multiple export formats, and a REST API facilitate reproducible analysis and integration into bioinformatics workflows.
name: NORMA
